about.title: About
about.description: Folioneer is a personal portfolio manager designed to track your financial assets across multiple accounts. It lets you record purchases, monitor your positions, and follow your cost basis over time. All data is stored locally on your device.
about.up_to_date: The application is up to date.

settings.title: Settings
settings.auto_record_price_label: Automatically record transaction price as market price
settings.auto_record_price_description: When enabled, new transaction forms will have the auto-record checkbox pre-checked.
settings.auto_fetch_description: When enabled, the app fetches current prices from Yahoo Finance for all active holdings every time it starts.
settings.scheduled_fetch_description: Downloads closing prices and exchange rates once per day at the chosen time — even when the app is closed.

scheduled_fetch.status_failed: Last download failed on {{executedAt}}. It will be retried automatically.
scheduled_fetch.status_skipped: Last check on {{executedAt}}: prices were already up to date.

settings.agents_allowed_description: An agent on this computer (Claude Code, Claude Desktop) may ask to read and record in your portfolio while Folioneer is open. Each connection waits for your answer. Off: nothing can connect.
settings.agents_unavailable_description: Not available on this system yet. Nothing can connect.

agent.connection_started_by_unknown: a program of yours, on this computer
agent.connection_covers: If you allow, until you disconnect or close Folioneer, it may:
agent.connection_covers_read: read your accounts, assets, holdings and totals;
agent.connection_never: Your answer covers the whole session. It cannot change, remove or undo a transaction — not even one it recorded — and it never reads a file, a setting or your sync folder.
agent.connection_covers_record: record opening balances, purchases and sales — up to 500 in a session — each shown here as it happens and marked as recorded by it.

sync.title: Multi-device sync
sync.local_copy_note: The copy published to the shared folder is encrypted with your sync passphrase. The copy kept on this computer is not encrypted.
sync.no_recovery_note: If you forget the passphrase, the published copy cannot be decrypted and there is no way to recover it. You can still start over from any computer that holds the portfolio.
sync.metadata_exposure_note: Whoever hosts the folder can see file names, sizes and dates — so when and roughly how much the portfolio is used, and how many computers share it — but not your accounts, holdings or amounts.
sync.computers_note: Each computer publishes its changes to the shared folder and applies the others'.
sync.rename_hint: How the other computers see this one.
sync.folder_hint: The shared folder every computer reads and writes.
sync.leave_hint: This computer stops syncing. Its portfolio stays here; the shared folder is untouched.
sync.start_over_hint: Discards every published file and publishes this computer's portfolio again, under a new passphrase.

join_refused.title: This computer already holds accounts or transactions, so it cannot join.
join_refused.why: Joining replaces everything here with the shared portfolio. To join, start from an empty installation:
join_refused.step_keep: Note or export anything you want to keep.
join_refused.step_rename: Close Folioneer and rename its data folder (below).

sync.start_over_confirm_title: Start over with a new passphrase?
sync.start_over_confirm_message: Every file published to the shared folder will be discarded and every other computer will have to rejoin from a fresh installation.

enable_modal.title: Enable sync
enable_modal.folder_hint: A folder synchronised by your cloud client (Dropbox, Drive, Syncthing…) or on a USB key you carry between computers. The application never connects to the internet.

enable_modal.start_over_wording: This folder already holds a portfolio. Choose a new sync passphrase: the published copy will be replaced by this computer's portfolio.
